spec2def(mydocs.dll mydocs.spec)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

set(ICONS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../win32/shell32/res/icons)
file(GLOB_RECURSE mydocs_rc_deps res/*.* ${ICONS_DIR}/235.ico ${ICONS_DIR}/236.ico)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# mydocs.dll is all Rust (mydocs-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mydocs-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# CMyDocsDropHandler.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mydocs-rust/src/mydocs/CMyDocsDropHandler_cpp_h.rs)
# mydocs.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mydocs-rust/src/mydocs/mydocs_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mydocs_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mydocs_shims PRIVATE uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libadvapi32 libshell32 libuser32 libcomctl32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(mydocs_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(mydocs mydocs-cargo mydocs.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE mydocs-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mydocs_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
